notes.title: Release 1.0.9.133
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Tutorial is no longer mandatory
[*] Bigger urgent messages in tutorial
[*] Better handling when joining servers end of round
[*] Map time blinking if less than 30 seconds remaining
[*] More reliable display of player levels on mini scoreboard 
[*] Round end scoreboard no longer continues to show unlocks after map change
[*] Sufficient space for 16 players on round end scoreboard
[*] Only open race finished screen when TAB-scoreboard closed
[*] Better display of difficulty class unlocks on race finished screen
[*] Only displaying fee warning for insufficient coins once
[*] No longer possible to get negative coins balance
[*] Optimised handling of ghosts in database
[/list]

notes.title: The Ocean Drop Update is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Try out Ocean Drop, the latest single player chapter with five new missions!
Collect pick-ups, deal with nasty weather and land on floating rafts![/h3]
[list]
[*] Five new missions with achievements
[*] Strong winds, nasty hail, bouncy weather balloons and clouds
[*] All new pick-up system
[*] Three different landing rafts
[*] Ocean environment with new water and sky systems
[/list]
This update also includes:
[list]
[*] Updated game engine
[*] Visual effects on deadly walls for 'The Hop'
[*] Fix for the short-cut on 'The Big One'
[*] Reliability improvements on best time ghosts
[*] Fix on the 'play' button when selecting single player chapters
[*] Adjusted thrust curves for low fps
[*] New warning message for low fps
[*] Updated Max FPS options: Off, 60, 120, 144, 240
[*] Optimised materials and cam sequences
[/list]
Release 1.0.9.117
